summary: Iteration 96: Quotation Offline Module testing complete. All 24 pytest tests passed. Backend APIs: 9 quotation endpoints (list, create, get, update, delete, pdf, store-prefill, get-prefill, mark-converted, sync-offline) + buyer sync-offline endpoint. All endpoints correctly return 401 for invalid auth tokens. PDF service generates valid PDFs with DRAFT watermark for offline quotations. Frontend has proper data-testid attributes on quotation page components. SyncEngine has correct priority order (buyer→quotation→invoice→inventory→purchase_order). OfflineStore supports 'quotation' and 'buyer' types.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 96 adds Quotation Offline Module tests. All backend endpoints require Firebase auth (return 401 without valid token). The quotation-to-invoice conversion flow uses dual storage: sessionStorage for immediate use + server-side prefill via store-prefill/get-prefill endpoints for page refresh resilience. PDF generation uses reportlab and supports DRAFT watermark for offline-synced quotations. SyncEngine processes offline items in order: buyer → quotation → invoice → inventory → purchase_order.
